examples.title: A service health dashboard from four objects
examples.body: Metric cards, a status table, a checklist and a latency chart composed into one grid. The same grid writes a PNG for chat and email and an HTML page for a browser.

examples.title: Trend against a target
examples.body: Two series, a target line and release markers. One definition renders PNG and SVG.

examples.title: Compliance by ring
examples.body: Group-Object turns machine rows into percentages; progress bars show them.

examples.title: Storage by department
examples.body: Share sizes summed per department and drawn as a labelled treemap.

examples.title: Month-over-month cost bridge
examples.body: A waterfall from an ordered hashtable: the keys become labels, the values become steps.

examples.title: Stacked bars from a CSV
examples.body: Titles, category labels and the bar layout are parameters, so a CSV export becomes a stacked chart in one command.

examples.title: Service map from a dependency list
examples.body: Tiers become columns and callers become edges. The same map writes a PNG and an interactive HTML page with pan, zoom and node details.

examples.title: Organization chart from directory data
examples.body: Manager links become the hierarchy; disabled accounts are flagged for review.

examples.title: Animated request flow
examples.body: A scenario walks a request across the map. SVG animates in the browser; GIF works in chat.

examples.title: Animated terminal session
examples.body: Commands and output replayed as animated SVG, HTML or GIF for documentation and release notes.

examples.title: Link preview card
examples.body: A 1200 x 630 canvas of text and info tiles, built from the same objects as the report.
